description: For an APPROVED agency: look a business up on Google right now — current rating, review count, hours, website, phone and whether it's open — and compare with ShearQuery's stored data. Capped at 5 per agency per 24 hours, so use it on businesses about to be pitched. What it finds also refreshes ShearQuery's directory.
name: prospect_live_check
title: Check a prospect live on Google
